spanish: Y clamó a Jehová, y le mostró Jehová un árbol, y lo arrojó a las aguas, y se endulzaron las aguas. Allí puso a él estatuto y juicio, y allí lo probó.

findings.issue: «lo» is an unmarked supplied object. The throw verb has no object suffix or object noun, so the pronoun resolves the ellipsis by identifying the tree as what was thrown.

notes: The rest matches person, number, stem, and the repeated שָׁם.
